description: Integer Sequence Identifier — Identifies an integer sequence from terms (a JSON array or pasted text), an OEIS A-number, a safe-parsed formula or recurrence, or a description, and leads with a verdict, confidence, A-number, formula, next terms and a next step. Searches the OEIS directly, then superseeker-style (differences, partial sums, gcd, ratios, binomial, Euler, leading terms, plus a search without the last two terms to f

aNumber.description: Alternative to terms: an OEIS A-number (A000108) or oeis.org URL. The entry is fetched and its data searched for related sequences; returns its name, formulas and next terms.

count.description: How many terms to expand from the formula; default 20.

description.description: Alternative to terms and formula: a plain-language description. A short description that names an entry (up to 4 content words, all in the entry name, e.g. Catalan numbers) is resolved by OEIS text search with no model; otherwise one fast model call proposes terms and keywords, which OEIS then confirms.

explain.description: Ask a model for a one-sentence explanation drawn only from the matched OEIS entry; its quote is verified in code, otherwise the entry name is returned. Default false.

formula.description: Alternative to terms: a closed form in n such as "binomial(2*n,n)/(n+1)", or a recurrence such as "a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2)" (with initialTerms). Operators + - * / % ^, functions binomial fact abs gcd min max floor mod. Evaluated by a safe parser, never eval; every term must be an integer.

initialTerms.description: Seed values a(start), a(start+1), ... for a recurrence formula.

start.description: Index n of the first expanded term; default 0.

terms.description: Integer terms, 4 to 60, each at most 40 digits. Pass values beyond 2^53 as decimal strings.

termsText.description: Alternative to terms: the terms pasted as text, separated by commas, spaces or semicolons (for example copied from a spreadsheet, a paper or an OEIS data line).

name: sequence-identifier
